title: Sunny and the Moss Path | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka discovers a soft carpet of glowing green moss running along the moonlit creek bank, and every single step she takes is completely silent and springy. A gentle bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
Sunny felt the difference before she saw it.

One step, her paw pressed into soil and leaf litter — then the next step, something different.

Something soft. Springy. Green.

She looked down.

Moss. A thick, lush carpet of it, running along the creek bank as far as she could see in the moonlight. Bright green in the daytime — she guessed — but right now silver-green and glowing with reflected moonlight.

She took another step onto the moss.

Silent.

Absolutely, perfectly silent.

Sunny laughed quietly. She had never walked so silently in her life.

She kept going, placing each paw with great care on the soft surface, marvelling at the hush. Every step was like stepping on a cloud. No crunch, no rustle, no scratch. Just softness and quiet.

The moss was cool and a little damp against her paws. It smelled of deep earth and growing things and the quiet places where sunlight doesn't quite reach.

She stopped in the middle of it and stood still.

The bush around her was already quiet. But with no footsteps, there was nothing at all. Complete and utter stillness.

Sunny sat down on the moss.

She pressed her paws flat against it and felt it gently push back — alive, breathing, soft.

She lay down.

The moss held her perfectly.

Soft as the gentlest bed in the whole wide world.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, moss path. Goodnight, little one.
